simple.meaning: קִיטוֹר (qîyṭôwr) is a Hebrew word meaning “a fume , i.e. cloud.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: קִיטוֹר (H7008) appears 4 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Genesis 19:28, with occurrences in Genesis, Psalms.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to קִיטוֹר (H7008) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in קִיטוֹר (H7008) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: קִיטוֹר (qîyṭôwr) / H7008 is traced through Genesis 19:28, Psalms 119:83, Psalms 148:8 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
